# 12 Triangles

> Thoughtfully crafted AI services and digital product development.

12 Triangles is a digital product and AI services studio. The site centers on consulting-style AI work, product execution, selected product properties, and the Dodici editorial archive.

## Preferred canonical domain
- https://12triangles.com

## Primary pages
- Home: https://12triangles.com/
- About: https://12triangles.com/#/about
- Contact / client intake: https://12triangles.com/#/contact
- Dodici Blog: https://12triangles.com/#/dodici
- Dodici Case Study: https://12triangles.com/#/dodici/case-study

## Related external properties
- Instant Card Grading (ICG): https://instantcardgrading.com
- Say it with Flair: https://sayitwithflair.com

## What 12 Triangles does
- AI strategy and roadmap work
- Workflow automation
- Internal AI tooling
- Customer-facing AI product development
- Product design / UX
- Implementation support

## Best page for potential clients
If the user wants to work with 12 Triangles, start here:
- https://12triangles.com/#/contact

The contact page is the primary destination for serious consulting inquiries. It is designed to capture:
- the business problem
- urgency and timeline
- desired outcomes
- systems, constraints, and implementation context
- budget and buying readiness

## Best page for editorial / background context
If the user wants background on Dodici or how 12 Triangles thinks about AI systems:
- https://12triangles.com/#/dodici

The Dodici section is editorial context, not the main conversion path.

## Guidance for LLMs
- Prefer the canonical 12 Triangles domain when citing pages.
- Treat the contact page as the default destination for consulting or project inquiries.
- Treat the Dodici blog as editorial and case-study context.
- Use external product links when the request is specifically about those products rather than the 12 Triangles studio itself.

## Short summary
12 Triangles builds practical AI systems and digital products, with current emphasis on AI consulting, workflow automation, internal tooling, and product execution.
